_comment: Input format for build-batch.mjs. Run: node scripts/social-kit/build-batch.mjs scripts/social-kit/example-content.json
_defaults: Filled into every post that does not set the slot itself. A per-post slot always wins. Naming a slot a given template lacks is fine and silently skipped.
_slots: Give a string for a one-line node, or an array for a multi-line block. Arrays keep the template's own leading and its final italic accent line at any line count.
